APPROVE

The nested `foreach`/`if`/`break` block moved verbatim into `AppendPrerequisites`, which cuts well over the one point needed from `AppendMakeRecipes`. The extracted loop keeps the same `MaxMakeTargets` check and the same `AppendRule` call, so behaviour is unchanged. I could only review the diff, not the full file, so I didn't confirm the parameter types against the caller or run the build, and nothing in the diff suggests a build break.
